host_model: shared-host exploratory; existing services and competing work retained
sanitization: Allowlisted fields, not a full report. Absolute paths, argv, raw output, environment paths and source inventories are private. Hashes bind original reports. All command records, timed samples, excluded warmups, output hashes and bracket host observations are retained below. These hashes are audit references, not a public re-execution closure.
control_summary_export_enrichment: The private derived N1/N4 analysis contains eight statistical fields. Its method label and per-lane median/p95 are added here from the same timed records to match the complete Rust Summary schema. Original stored numerical control fields are preserved.
inference_assumptions: Equivalent work; representative independent pairs for bootstrap; sign exchangeability under the null for sign flips. Gates and bracket host observations do not prove these assumptions. Nine exploratory comparisons, no multiplicity correction.
review_limitations: Three-lane ordering reverses forward/backward; bluefe-n1 always occupies the middle position. Position and cache history remain confounders.

Runtime, project-test and rejection gates invoke selected tools directly without the timed N1/N4 frontend options. They qualify those toolchain invocations, not runtime equivalence under both scheduling modes.
Stock and BlueFe use different rustc, LLVM and Cargo revisions. This is not a same-version compiler-family comparison.
